approved_allocation_modalities.item_visit_order: Interleave task-local item lists in input order: A1, B1, A2, B2, etc.; reuse this order for another candidate round.
approved_allocation_modalities.shared_sources: Deduplicate serialized shared bundles while retaining all task/item associations and counting distinct seeds globally.
approved_allocation_modalities.atomic_dependencies: Keep all required eligible dependencies and metadata; never trim warnings/footnotes to fit.
approved_allocation_modalities.non_fitting_bundle: Report the affected item and budget reason; continue considering other feasible items.
approved_allocation_modalities.accounting: Do not equate budget incompleteness with absent or quarantined source, input ambiguity, or full request completeness.
